title: Chrome Shortcuts You Need Now #Shorts
description: Learn essential Google Chrome keyboard shortcuts to boost your productivity instantly.
script: Stop wasting time clicking around. Master these Chrome shortcuts to browse like a pro. First, hit Ctrl plus Shift plus T to instantly restore that accidentally closed tab. Finally, jump between open tabs using Ctrl plus Tab. These simple tricks will save you hours of effort every single week. Start using them right now!
